question: Who is the Founder Director of ISRO's Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr S Unnikrishnan Nair**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dr. S. Unnikrishnan Nair is the founder and director of the Indian Space Research Organisation's (ISRO) Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC)
 
• The HSFC was established in 2019 to implement India's Human Space Flight Programme.
 
• The centre's primary role is to lead the Gaganyaan program, which aims to launch a crew of three into a 400 km orbit for a three-day mission.
 
• The crew will then land safely in Indian waters. 
 
• The HSFC's responsibilities include Planning missions, Developing engineering systems for crew survival, Selecting and training crews, and Overseeing activities for sustained human space flight missions. 
 
• The current director of the HSFC is Dinesh Kumar Singh, a Distinguished Scientist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• R Hutton is the project director for the Gaganyaan project, which aims to send humans into space.
 
• Dr. K Sivan is the former chairman of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• Dr. K Kasturirangan is a renowned Indian astrophysicist and former chairman of ISRO.
